name: Edge Athlete — Rack
_comment_id: Chrome identifies an installed app by `id`, falling back to `start_url` when it is absent. All three manifests used to share start_url '/', so all three were the SAME app to the browser — installing the coach app just renamed the rack one in place. A distinct `id` is what makes them three separate installs. It is an identity string only: it is never navigated to and does not need to be a real route.
description: Rack tablet for live barbell velocity tracking.
_comment_start_url: Stays '/' on purpose, unlike coach and dashboard. A rack's number is not known at install time, so it launches into the dispatcher at '/' and lets Home redirect to /rack/N from the stored rack_number. Identity comes from `id` above, so sharing '/' with nothing else costs nothing.
